title: Shape Privacy
question: Choose a reading layout for the short public note. All three cover the agreed first release; preview copy still needs verification before publication. This selects a design, not implementation.

options.label: By how you use The Lobby
options.thesis: A short note follows visiting, signing in, and connecting a calendar.
options.viewport: Compact Lobby header, Privacy introduction, three clearly headed reading sections, then service logs and removal.
options.risk: Details shared across activities need one final section to avoid repetition.
materials: Rubik headings and Nunito Sans prose

options.label: What we keep / What you control
options.thesis: Each data use sits beside the choice a person can make.
options.viewport: Privacy and a short opening lead into quiet paired rows for sign-in, teams, calendars, and logs.
options.risk: Paired rows scan well on desktop but need a careful reading order on phones.
materials: Rubik headings and Nunito Sans prose

options.label: A note with an index
options.thesis: A small topic index makes a single readable note easy to revisit.
options.viewport: The Lobby header, Privacy title, a narrow contents rail, and one continuous reading column.
options.risk: An index may feel heavier than this short note needs.
materials: Rubik headings and Nunito Sans prose
